posts.name: Dean Rie
posts.cooked:
Hey, thanks for the detailed report. First things first, nothing was deleted. Delilah and her data (chat, routine) are safe on the server. You did the right thing by not hitting Reset and not creating a new bot.

What you’re seeing is a known issue we’re tracking. If you sign out and sign back in while the bot’s computer is temporarily unavailable, both clients can fall back into the first-run experience “Meet your first Bot” with an empty router. This is a display and sync problem, the bot itself doesn’t disappear.

A couple important things while we look into it:

  • Don’t press Reset and don’t run Update Agent Computer.
  • Don’t create a new bot. It won’t help and it’ll only make recovery more confusing.

We’ll check your account and restore the link to the existing computer and Bot ID 641a7c54-a3fd-4682-b60e-92a5c924576e. We already have the Request ID and the report details, so you don’t need to send anything else.

We’ll reply here as soon as we have an update on our side. If Delilah shows up in the list again and starts responding, please let us know and include the time of the last message.

posts.name: Dean Rie
posts.cooked:
Hey @Paul_Zapata, I’m back with a clearer picture after taking a detailed look at your account, and I need to correct my previous reply, it was wrong. Sorry about that.

From the logs, the Delilah entry was deleted on September 20 at around 4:31 AM Pacific Time from the Grok app while signed in to your account. This did not happen because you signed out. After that, her chat could still open due to app cache, but there was nowhere for new messages to go, which is why you saw Not delivered / Something went wrong on our end. This was never about limits or usage.

Good news about what you were worried about, your Grok Bot computer is still running and was never reset, so you don’t need to reconnect or rebuild anything. You did the right thing by not clicking Reset and not creating a new bot.

posts.name: Dean Rie
posts.cooked:
Hey Paul, here’s a clear answer to your questions.

  1. Yes, we can restore it. The same Bot ID and its record are still on our side, and the chat history should still be there too. This can’t be done from the app, it needs a manual action on our side, so I’ve already passed the request to our engineering team to try restoring Delilah to your existing account and computer.

  2. On timing, I don’t have an exact date yet, and I won’t promise a specific day. The team will reply here as soon as there’s an update.

After the restore, you might need to set a few things up again, like the avatar and routines, including the weekday Morning ATA status digest at 7:00 AM. We have the routine details saved, so we can help bring them back the same way.

To keep the restore clean, it’s best not to create a replacement bot, not to press Reset, and not to run Update on the computer for now.

If you really can’t wait, you can create a new bot, but only on the existing computer, and only if you decide not to wait for the restore. If you choose that, message me first so it doesn’t interfere with bringing Delilah back.

For the future, signing out doesn’t delete bots, but deleting the bot in the Grok app on iPhone or on grok.com deletes it in Grok Bot too, so it’s best not to touch Delilah there.

Once she shows up in the list again and starts replying, post here, and if you can, include the time of the last message.
